portugal_policy.title: 🇵🇹 Portugal Policy & Law
portugal_policy.content:
• **Decreto-Lei n.º 112/2026 (Energy Efficiency Credits):** Increases the personal income tax (IRS) credit for energy efficiency renovations in rented properties. Previously: 15% of expenses. Now: 25% of expenses, capped at €2,500 per property. Enters into force on December 1, 2026. This incentivizes landlords to modernize older building stock to meet updated climate standards. Diário da República.

• **Lei n.º 44/2026 (Startup Scale-up Incentive):** Reduces the autonomous tax rate on distributed profits for certified "Scale-up" companies. Previously: 28% flat rate. Now: 15% for dividends distributed within the first 60 months of certification. In force as of November 12, 2026. This increases the net yield for venture capital investors in high-growth Portuguese tech firms. Jornal de Negócios.

• **Portaria n.º 310/2026 (2027 Minimum Wage):** Establishes the National Minimum Wage (RMMG) for the upcoming calendar year. Previously: €870/month. Now: €920/month (a 5.7% increase) effective January 1, 2027. This will increase operational overhead for labor-intensive businesses across all sectors. Portugal.gov.pt.

• **Despacho n.º 891/2026 (VAT Exemption Threshold):** Raises the annual turnover threshold for VAT exemption for self-employed workers under Article 53. Previously: €14,500. Now: €16,000. In force as of November 10, 2026. This reduces the administrative and accounting burden for approximately 120,000 low-income freelancers. Diário da República.

Why it matters: The reduction of the autonomous tax rate for Scale-ups significantly improves the after-tax ROI for investors in the Portuguese technology sector.

eu_policy.title: 🇪🇺 European Union Policy
eu_policy.content:
No significant EU regulations, directives, or decisions were formally adopted or published in the Official Journal of the EU between November 9 and November 16, 2026.

Close to adoption/application:
• **The AI Act (High-Risk Systems):** Compliance for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III is approaching the August 2027 application deadline. The Commission is expected to release further delegated acts to refine technical thresholds for "high-risk" classification.
• **Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD):** The transition period is nearing completion for the first tier of affected companies (5,000+ employees and €1.5bn turnover), with full application of due diligence obligations mandated by 2027.
• **Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD):** The 2026 reporting cycle is currently active, requiring large undertakings (non-NFRD) to submit their first mandatory sustainability reports based on the 2025 fiscal year.

Why it matters: The EU regulatory environment has shifted from a phase of legislative adoption to a critical implementation window for the AI Act and ESG frameworks.

This reinforces the bearish trend as real yields climb, making gold and silver less attractive relative to bonds. [Source: Treasury Markets]

This indicates a fundamental repricing of AI-exposed tech assets amid higher borrowing costs. [Source: Market Technicals]

This move suggests investors are hedging against the inflationary pressures implied by rising yields. [Source: Sector Flow Data]

Why it matters: The 100bps Treasury yield surge is the primary driver of today's risk-off sentiment, aggressively discounting growth valuations and non-yielding commodities.

ai_productivity.title: ⚡ AI & Productivity
ai_productivity.content:
• **Microsoft:** Phi-3-vision is a 4.2B parameter multimodal model featuring a 128k context window and open-weights availability. It outperforms LLaVA-1.5 on VQAv2 benchmarks and provides a high-performance, small-footprint alternative to GPT-4o for image reasoning. [Practical impact]: Developers can now deploy high-accuracy image-to-text analysis on local edge devices or laptops without paying API tokens. [Microsoft Blog]

• **Mistral AI:** Codestral is a 22B parameter model specifically optimized for code generation across 80+ languages with a 32k context window. It excels at Fill-In-the-Middle (FIM) tasks and demonstrates frontier-level performance on HumanEval benchmarks. [Practical impact]: Developers can now integrate a dedicated, low-latency coding model into their IDEs that rivals the reasoning of larger general-purpose models. [Mistral AI Blog]

• **Perplexity:** Perplexity Pages is a new product feature that transforms AI-driven research threads into structured, formatted, and publishable web pages. It shifts the tool from a conversational search engine to a knowledge-base creator, allowing users to curate findings into cohesive articles. [Practical impact]: A knowledge worker can replace the 3-step process of researching, copying to Notion, and manually formatting with a single "Convert to Page" command. [Perplexity Blog]

Why it matters: The simultaneous release of high-performance specialized models (Codestral, Phi-3) suggests a pivot from monolithic general AI toward a modular, "right-sized" model ecosystem.
